WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award
    GROUP BY player_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT pc.player_id,
       pc.award_count,
       CASE WHEN tc.total_count IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1.0 * pc.award_count / tc.total_count
       END AS fraction
FROM player_counts pc
CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
